title: Tip from Angela - How to Get a Job as Programmer
summary: Short career tip for learners aiming at a developer job: demonstrated skills and collaboration matter more than formal credentials.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Most employers weigh what a candidate can do above where they studied. A minority have hard degree filters, but they are the exception.
Build a portfolio. Browse job listings on sites like Indeed or LinkedIn, note the skills requested, and create projects that show those skills.
Show teamwork as well: answer questions on Stack Overflow or in the course Q&A, and take part in code reviews with more senior developers.
Good team members work with people both above them (to learn from) and below them (to teach). Building a visible record of both helps convince recruiters.
